transmission.natural_missingness: excluded from the denominator; never locally available
transmission.packet_loss_cost: counted on TX attempts, not deliveries

periodic_fixed_k.rule: TRANSMIT iff t % k == 0, then SKIP if not local_available
periodic_fixed_k.missingness: does not shift later TX times; the counter still advances

primary_event.definition: combined OR: y >= 1000 ppm OR rise >= 150 ppm vs previous finite GT
primary_event.server_state: same rule on reconstructed monitoring value (TX ground truth or recon/LOCF)
primary_event.skip_semantics: SKIP is not an automatic FN; skip + correct reconstruction can be TP
primary_event.high_co2_and_rapid_rise: logged separately as secondary; revision tables report the combined event

packet_loss.mask: shared (t, sensor) Bernoulli mask, identical across methods for a given loss_mask_id

hierarchy.deterministic: mean and sample SD across shared loss-mask replicates
hierarchy.kl_cmappo: mean over masks within each frozen policy, then sample SD across the 5 policies
hierarchy.not: 25 policy×mask rows are not 25 i.i.d. trained models

packet_loss.bc: legacy per-attempt packet-loss rows are not used in the new shared-mask figure

delta_selection.feasible: MAE<=9 and miss rate<=0.015 and AoI<=3.5
delta_selection.if_none_feasible: Pareto set → min violation_score → max TX reduction

constraints.aggregation: k/n pass counts; False if any contributing replicate fails

matched_budget.kl: direct VAL tau sweep on frozen actors; report the measured tau nearest each target
matched_budget.bc: interpolated estimate from legacy frozen summary only; not primary

generalization_figure.comparison: development cohort TEST vs held-out cohort TEST (same temporal test window)
generalization_figure.not: VAL vs held-out TEST (would confound sensors with time)
